title: Sparkly robot vacuum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fd6ff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='44' ry='16' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <g fill='#fff6a0'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='20' ry='5' fill='#b9c6d9'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='16' ry='3.6' fill='#d6e0ee'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='2.4' fill='#5affd0'/>
  <!-- front trim -->
  <path d='M22 68 a30 9 0 0 0 56 0' fill='none' stroke='#7fd6ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- side wheels -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='72' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#3d4a6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='72' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#3d4a6b'/>
